name: parkrun Austria
notes: Not built: blocked_by explicit anti-scraping policy. robots.txt on www.parkrun.co.at states verbatim 'We request that automated scraping does not take place' (plus a Disallow on /results/ and /*/futureroster, which is exactly where per-date occurrence info would live), and parkrun.com/scraping states 'parkrun does not condone the scraping of our data' and points to an Anti-Scraping Policy. Homepage/events page are only reachable with a browser-like Referer/Accept-Language (plain UA gets a 403), consistent with active anti-bot posture. Respecting this per the same policy applied to vhs.at/vienna.at; no data fetched or written.
